versions.changelog:
No functional or content changes detected in this release.

- Documentation references updated for clarity and generality; specific file paths have been removed from reference descriptions.
- No code or workflow changes were made; overall skill functionality remains unchanged.

- Initial release of the yazhou-enterprise-service skill, providing one-stop service for Yazhou District enterprise staff.
- Supports enterprise information inquiries, targeted policy recommendations, production safety supervision, and development advice tailored to Yazhou District industry trends.
- Can generate service reports for one or multiple enterprises at once, outputting in Word (.docx) format.
- Integrates with external tools to fetch business and financial data, including for listed companies.
- Includes detailed templates for structuring enterprise service reports, safety supervision records, and development suggestions.
- Provides guidance on workflow, information accuracy, and the use of policy/industry reference materials.
